name: cinematicNoir
title: Cinematic Noir
description: Deep atmospheric shadows, silvery tungsten key highlights, subtle anamorphic streak flares, and deliberate weighted pacing for dramatic intrigue.
do: Embrace negative space and heavy shadowy silhouettes
Use high letter tracking for title headers to create cinematic breathing room
Employ slow, weighted camera drifts with gradual focal depth transitions
dont: Do not use overly fast, snappy, or bouncy spring transitions
Avoid high saturation neon colors or rainbow spectrum elements
Never blow out background layers with flat ambient illumination
